title: Everyday Phrases — A Job Interview
scene_zh: 求職面試 · 情境對話
title_quote: I saw a great job posting today.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💼 實用求職面試必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Job Interview
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用求職面試情境對話：從投履歷、約時間、前台報到、自我介紹、談薪水到接 offer，每兩句成一組（男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Job Interview phrase pairs, from sending your resume and scheduling the interview to small talk, salary negotiation and accepting the offer (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw a great job posting today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ə ɡreɪt dʒɑb ˈpoʊstɪŋ təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我今天看到一個很棒的招聘信息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a marketing role downtown.
dialogue.zh: 是市區的一個行銷職位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have an updated resume?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's from two years ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Update the dates on your resume.
dialogue.zh: 把履歷上的日期更新一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll add my latest project too.
dialogue.zh: 我也會加上我最近的專案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your resume to two pages.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, keep it to half a page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, kip ɪt tu hæf ə peɪdʒ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say why you want this job.
dialogue.zh: 寫清楚你為什麼想要這份工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Match them to the job ad.
dialogue.zh: 把技能和職缺對照著寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I will tailor it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send a fresh letter each time.
dialogue.zh: 每次都要寫新的求職信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save the file as a PDF.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðə faɪl æz ə ˌpiː diː ˈɛf./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll add the job title too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 用電子郵件投遞也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What subject line should I use?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the job title as the subject.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə dʒɑb ˈtaɪtəl æz ðə ˈsʌbdʒɪkt./
dialogue.zh: 就用職位名稱當信件主旨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你認識那家公司的人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, so he can forward it.
dialogue.zh: 要，這樣他可以幫你轉傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is Sam from Bright Tech.
dialogue.zh: 我是 Bright Tech 的山姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們今天收到你的履歷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you come to our office?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a lot behind the building.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə lɑt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 大樓後面有一個停車場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will meet the team lead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll think of three by morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 要了解他們的主要業務。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好點子，我查他們的職位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 請問登記的是哪個名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The meeting room is this way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your resume made a strong impression.
dialogue.zh: 你的履歷讓人印象深刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I updated it twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too. Thanks for having me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you been a coordinator?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju bɪn ə koʊˈɔrdəˌneɪtər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you ever led a team?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small team of three.
dialogue.zh: 帶過，一個三人的小團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 粉絲數成長了百分之四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do you want to leave?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒有問題，我們合作得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 為什麼特別選擇我們公司？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你們的產品符合我的理念。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you like about it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We worked hard on that app.
dialogue.zh: 那款應用是我們用心做出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you want to be in two years?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ju wɑnt tu bi ɪn tu jɪrz?/
dialogue.zh: 兩年後你想成為什麼樣子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 帶領一個小的產品團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我會列一張清楚的清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me about your team style.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，那是我的目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們的客戶電話都用英文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們來看看你的專案經驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which project should I see first?
dialogue.zh: 你建議我先看哪個專案？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 從去年的上架專案開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你在裡面的確切角色是？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們砍掉了一些小功能。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我跟供應商把價格談下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有效，我們省了百分之十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 規劃和清楚的書面表達。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I ask for facts, not feelings.
dialogue.zh: 我會追問事實而非情緒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我害怕打陌生的開發電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我那波活動讓註冊倍增。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our designer did most of it.
dialogue.zh: 是我們設計師出了最多力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有一次郵件行銷完全失敗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大範圍發送前先小規模測試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It taught me the hard way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我想先知道你們的範圍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can offer forty five thousand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 低於這個數字你可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我得留一個月的交接期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe two and a half weeks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you feel about working from home?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju fil əˈbaʊt ˈwɜrkɪŋ frʌm hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 你對於在家上班的感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你家裡的工作環境備妥了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a quiet room and fast internet.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə ˈkwaɪət rum ænd fæst ˈɪntərˌnɛt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一個月出差一次沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你的時間安排有限制嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pick up my kid Fridays.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你有什麼想問我們的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I wrote down a few.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does a normal day look like?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ə ˈnɔrməl deɪ lʊk laɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 平常的一天是什麼樣子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What do you like about working here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ju laɪk əˈbaʊt ˈwɜrkɪŋ hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take care, we'll be in touch.
dialogue.zh: 路上小心，我們會跟你聯繫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you send a thank you note?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju sɛnd ə θæŋk ju noʊt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, I'll write it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們想安排第二輪面試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我需要額外準備什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 另外會有一個小案例題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam had great things to say.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plan a launch in two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now walk me through the steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那就代表我過關了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ms. Lee? We have an offer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten days a year, maybe more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday in three weeks, does that work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ɪn θri wiːks, dʌz ðæt wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 三週後的星期一到職，可以嗎？
